title: DASC Qwen3.6 Ascend piercing

paper.title: DASC: Decay-Aware State Compression for Hybrid Linear-Attention Serving

objective: Pierce DASC using the HYPIC-style evidence loop: method-chain parity, architecture fit, one-switch cache-hit A/B, Ascend correctness, matched performance, and E2E quality evidence.
next_actions: Validate Qwen3.6 GDN decay parameters and state layout in the installed Ascend runtime.
Build an offline DASC-GDN head-retention plan from weights and record compression arithmetic.
Identify whether vLLM-Ascend exposes recurrent state checkpoint store/load paths compatible with compressed checkpoints.
Implement the smallest fail-closed canary only after architecture and cache-store seams are proven.
